toast.reactivatedBody: {name} is active again and available to its users.
toast.deactivatedBody: {name}'s users can no longer sign in to Fusion.
toast.archivedBody: {name} has left the tenant list. Its users can no longer sign in.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: Its users will no longer be able to sign in to Fusion. All tenant data is kept, and you can reactivate the tenant at any time.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.description: Its users lose access for good and it leaves the tenant list. Tenant data is kept. This can't be undone.

failure.title: This tenant could not be loaded
failure.description: The tenant record is unavailable right now. Nothing about the tenant has changed.

lifecycle.label: Tenant lifecycle
lifecycle.activeDescription: This tenant is active and available to authorized users.
lifecycle.deactivatedDescription: Customer users cannot currently access Fusion. Existing tenant data is retained.
lifecycle.archivedDescription: Customer users can no longer access Fusion. Tenant data is kept.

toast.newSentDescription: A fresh onboarding invitation is on its way to the administrator.
toast.resentDescription: The onboarding invitation has been sent again.

recoveryRequired.description: No usable tenant administrator can currently sign in.
recoveryRequired.label: Recovery required

active.description: Administrative control has been transferred to the customer.
active.label: Active

deliveryFailed.description: The tenant is active, but the invitation was not delivered.
deliveryFailed.label: Delivery failed

pending.description: Control is being transferred to the customer administrator.
pending.label: Invitation pending

expired.description: The invitation expired before the administrator completed onboarding.
expired.label: Invitation expired

revoked.description: The invitation was revoked before it was accepted.
revoked.label: Invitation revoked

awaiting.description: Control has not yet been transferred to the customer.
awaiting.label: Awaiting administrator

describe.deliveryFailed: The administrator invitation could not be delivered.
describe.InvitationResent: The administrator invitation was sent again.
describe.InvitationReissued: A new administrator invitation was issued.

off.title: Turn off {product} for {tenant}?
off.description: People lose {product} as their sessions renew, within an hour. Its data, roles and role assignments are kept, and turning it back on restores them.

on.title: Turn on {product} for {tenant}?
on.description: People get {product} as their sessions renew, within an hour, with its data, roles and role assignments as they were.

recovery.title: Restore administration
recovery.description: Sends a verified customer representative an invitation to become tenant administrator. Platform gets no access to the tenant's workspace or data.
recovery.acknowledge: I confirm this recipient was verified with the customer.

problem.notEligible: This tenant has an administrator who can sign in again, so recovery no longer applies.
problem.alreadyPending: A recovery invitation is already pending.
problem.existingAccount: This email already belongs to a Fusion account.
problem.invalid: Enter a valid email and confirm the verification.
problem.unexpected: The recovery invitation couldn't be sent. Try again.
